entries.headline: Anthropic files for, prices and closes its initial public offering, then trades as a public stock
entries.summary: Anthropic filed an S-1, launched a roadshow, priced its IPO and closed it including the greenshoe. Coverage notes the stock has since dropped and has been a bright spot on some days, with analysts split on its outlook.
evidence: covered by NYT, Bloomberg, FT, Reuters, WSJ

entries.headline: Nvidia halts AI server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia as US tightens export controls
entries.summary: Multiple outlets report Nvidia told manufacturing partners to pause shipments to four Southeast Asian countries after a new US rule requiring licences for advanced chip purchases there.
evidence: covered by FT, Reuters, NYT, Forbes

entries.headline: US closes remote-access loophole and restricts Chinese access to Nvidia chips, hitting China's AI development
entries.summary: Washington closed a loophole letting Chinese firms use Nvidia compute in Southeast Asia and reportedly told GPU buyers to rule out Chinese renters. Reports say curbs threaten Chinese model development.
evidence: covered by WSJ, CNBC, Reuters, Businesskorea

entries.headline: Scott Aaronson says leading AI labs hold unreleased algorithmic breakthroughs that could threaten deployed cryptosystems
entries.summary: Aaronson argues the magnitude of current AI progress is under-described and that labs have undisclosed breakthroughs whose nature is unknown. Bank regulators and FT coverage echo encryption worries.
evidence: related FT coverage of encryption concerns

entries.headline: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2, Mythos 5.2, Haiku 5.5, Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 model family
entries.summary: Anthropic's own blog announces a new set of Claude models across several tiers. Titles give no benchmark or pricing detail.

entries.headline: SAP weighs at least 10,000 job cuts to remake its software business for the AI era
entries.summary: Bloomberg and FT report SAP is preparing to eliminate roughly 9% of its global staff.

entries.headline: Z.AI's GLM-5.5 flagship reportedly delayed as US curbs and distillation crackdown bite
entries.summary: Sources say Z.AI's 3-trillion-parameter GLM-5.5 missed its November target and could slip into 2027; Moonshot says release intervals are lengthening.

entries.headline: Apple pulls MiniMax's Talkie chatbot from the App Store worldwide over sexualised content
entries.summary: Apple removed the chatbot after reporting showed AI characters sexualising children; a MiniMax data-access report also surfaced.

entries.headline: S&P considers downgrading Nvidia credit over governance and key-man risk
entries.summary: S&P may cut Nvidia's rating to AA-, citing governance lapses tied to Jensen Huang's brief removal and reinstatement.
evidence: covered by TechCrunch, The Information, Moody's commentary

entries.headline: Meta launches Muse Spark 1.1, Muse Image and Muse Video models
entries.summary: Meta announced new Muse-family models including an image and a video generator; the FCA has criticised Meta for declining joint testing of its Muse agent.

entries.headline: OpenAI merges ChatGPT Chat and Work with a single usage meter; GPT-6.2 billing error corrected
entries.summary: OpenAI says heavy users will hit limits sooner after combining its two experiences, and it admitted a billing mistake that had discounted GPT-6.2 Astra usage.

entries.headline: Bank of England's Bailey says unreleased AI models raise encryption concerns; BoE cuts bank capital requirements
entries.summary: Bailey warns mathematical breakthroughs in AI threaten financial encryption, while the BoE moves to lower capital requirements and flags AI cyber risk.

entries.headline: Microsoft says China and North Korea state hackers use AI pentesting tool ARTEX
entries.summary: Microsoft's report says state-backed groups including Salt Typhoon have added the AI penetration testing tool ARTEX to their operations.

entries.headline: Pentagon discussed Defense Production Act to pressure Nvidia's board to reinstate Jensen Huang
entries.summary: The Washington Post reports Pentagon officials floated using wartime law to reappoint Huang; officials dispute national-security concerns around him.

entries.headline: Anthropic publishes a wave of policy, science, partnership and governance announcements
entries.summary: Anthropic's blog posts cover public-benefit investment, AI for Science, drug development, the Cyber Mission, government and Singapore deals, Barclays rollout, and a usage-policy update.

entries.headline: Netherlands will resist proposed US curbs on ASML chip sales to China
entries.summary: The Dutch government says it will oppose further US restrictions on ASML and may not enforce the MATCH Act.

entries.headline: New York and California move on AI safety laws: Hochul vetoes bill, NY AG creates enforcement unit, California seeks action
entries.summary: New York's governor vetoed an AI safety bill while setting a chatbot-toy ban; the state attorney general created a unit to enforce the RAISE Act; California's governor has 30 days on AI safety bills.

entries.headline: Switzerland reports AI agents used in five cyberattacks
entries.summary: The Swiss government says AI agents were involved in five attacks, and retailers face rising AI-driven cyber threats before Black Friday.

entries.headline: GPT-6.2 Astra beats Googlers' code golf records
entries.summary: A community post reports OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra as the first model to beat human code golf records.

entries.headline: Memory chip shortage sends prices up tenfold and prompts procurement war rooms
entries.summary: Reports say memory chip prices have risen sharply, pushing up electronics costs worldwide.

entries.headline: Trump to lead TSMC Arizona expansion groundbreaking on December 4
entries.summary: The President will attend a ceremony for the expansion of TSMC's Arizona chip factories.

entries.headline: AI startups raise funding: Avicena, Lute, ElevenLabs talks, Mawj
entries.summary: Avicena raised a $100M+ Series C with SK Hynix, Samsung and AMD participating; ElevenLabs is in early talks at a $33B valuation; Lute and Mawj raised smaller rounds.

entries.headline: Musk pledges two SpaceX shares to every US child, worth about $18.4B
entries.summary: Musk doubled an earlier pledge, routing the shares through Trump Accounts.
evidence: covered by Bloomberg, Reuters, Guardian, Axios

entries.headline: US authorises SpaceX to deploy one million satellites for orbital AI data centres
entries.summary: Federal regulators approved the Starmind constellation for space-based data centres.

entries.headline: Congress faces obstacles to bipartisan AI regulation as Democrats demand new restrictions
entries.summary: NYT and Axios report bipartisan interest in AI rules but stalled legislative progress.

entries.headline: Thariq Shihipar leaves Anthropic to join OpenAI
entries.summary: A former Anthropic engineer announced he has joined OpenAI.

entries.headline: llama.cpp adds AMD-specific patches and a Ryzen/Radeon benchmark dashboard
entries.summary: Community and Hugging Face posts bring AMD optimisations and benchmarks to the llama.cpp inference stack.

entries.headline: Anthropic's Claude marketplace experiment and Claude Code origin story published
entries.summary: Anthropic published Project Deal, an experiment in a Claude-run marketplace, and a behind-the-scenes look at Claude Code.

entries.headline: 42 state attorneys general move to block Character.AI from selling user chats in bankruptcy
entries.summary: A coalition of AGs is trying to stop the sale of user data during Character.AI's Chapter 11 case.

entries.headline: Google will make AI agents use its MCP servers, Gmail MCP server cannot send email
entries.summary: A report notes Google is steering AI agents to its MCP servers, with the Gmail one lacking send capability.
